in_sanskrit.name: अपुर्व
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Apurba is derived from the Sanskrit word 'apūrva' which means 'beyond' or 'before'. It suggests something that is new, unique, and incomparable. This name is often given to a child who is considered a blessing and a source of joy, as they are believed to bring something new and invaluable into the world.

in_hindi.name: अपुर्वा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Apurba in Hindi is 'Apurvā'. The meaning of the name is 'next' or 'following'. It suggests that the child is a continuation of the lineage and will carry on the traditions and values of their family and community.

in_tamil.name: அபுர்வ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Apurba in Tamil is 'Apurvam'. The meaning of the name is 'new' or 'recent'. It suggests that the child is a fresh beginning and brings something new and unique into the world. The name is also associated with the idea of being unparalleled or incomparable.

in_telugu.name: ఆపుర్బ
in_telugu.meaning: ఆపుర్బ (āpurbu) - beyond, in front, ahead, preceding
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Apurba in Telugu is 'Āpurbu'. The meaning of the name is 'beyond' or 'in front'. It suggests that the child is a pioneer, a leader, or someone who is ahead of their time. The name is also associated with the idea of being unique and incomparable.

in_marathi.name: Apurba
in_marathi.long_meaning: Apurba हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'beyond' or 'past'. It is a powerful and evocative name, resonating with the depth and complexity of the Hindu spiritual tradition.
